content.text: This website stores cookies on your computer. These cookies are used to improve the website and provide more personalized services to you, both on this website and through other media. To find out more, please see our Privacy Policy.ACCEPT Immunizations and Vaccines Immunization Schedules Vaccines are a crucial part of preventive public health, protecting patients across diseases and life stages. With shifting guidance from the federal government and some states, the voice of the family physician is vital in presenting patients with clear, evidence-based recommendations. The AAFP's 2026 immunization schedules help you stay up to date on vaccine recommendations, so your patients can stay up to date on their health.
